metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the worst hip pain relief exercises, and the BEST ones to do instead. 

We'll go over 4 common, but bad, hip pain stretches and exercises that may do more harm than good. Each exercise will focus on different movements of the hips.

Make sure to check out all of the exercises, it might just save your hips down the road!
